paraphrase: The omniscient eats: his body is the ordinary gross body, which lasts only by nourishment; the feeling-producing and life-span karmas that cause hunger remain until the final stages; eating without desire does not diminish omniscience or bliss, as the other bodily acts of the omniscient — walking, sitting, preaching — do not; and the scripture speaks of the Jina taking food.
speaker: Śākaṭāyana
